```{r}

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# Import dataset and insert missing column name for 1st column

RNASeqRaw <- read_csv("/Users/luke/bvg7003/oLLMpiques/Question_3/2_Data_RNASeq_Cannabis_Sex.csv") %>%
  rename(gene_id = 1)

```

```{r}
#Give first column a name
RNASeq <- RNASeqRaw %>% rename(Locus = ...1)
```

```{r}
#filter to REM16 and FT1
REM16RNASeq <- filter(RNASeqRaw, gene_id == "Cannabis_LOC115699937")
#REM16 had a different name but easier to call differently than rename
FT1RNASeq   <- filter(RNASeqRaw, gene_id == "LOC115696989")
```

```{r}
expr_long <- bind_rows(REM16 = REM16RNASeq, FT1 = FT1RNASeq, .id = "gene") %>%
  select(-gene_id) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -gene,
    names_to  = "sample_id",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sex = case_when(
      str_ends(sample_id, "_XX") ~ "Female (XX)",
      str_ends(sample_id, "_XY") ~ "Male (XY)"
    ),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female (XX)", "Male (XY)"))
  ) %>%
  drop_na(expression)
```

```{r}
sex_colors <- c("Female (XX)" = "#D55E00", "Male (XY)" = "#0072B2")
```

```{r}
p_rem16 <- expr_long %>%
  filter(gene == "REM16") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = expression, fill = sex)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sex_colors) +
  labs(title = "REM16 expression by plant sex", x = "Plant sex", y = "Expression") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_rem16
```

```{r}
p_ft1 <- expr_long %>%
  filter(gene == "FT1") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = expression, fill = sex)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sex_colors) +
  labs(title = "FT1 expression by plant sex", x = "Plant sex", y = "Expression") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_ft1
```

```{r}
p_combined <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = gene, y = expression, fill = sex)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sex_colors, name = "Plant sex") +
  labs(title = "REM16 and FT1 expression by plant sex", x = "Gene", y = "Expression") +
  theme_minimal()

p_combined
```

```{r}
ggsave("rem16_by_sex.png",    p_rem16,    width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("ft1_by_sex.png",      p_ft1,      width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("combined_by_sex.png", p_combined, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
